text: 赵乐际同全国人大常委会会议列席代表座谈时强调 深入学习贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神 加强人大代表思想政治和纪律作风建设
text_en: Zhao Leji, in a discussion with representatives attending the NPC Standing Committee session, stresses deep study and implementation of the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and strengthening NPC deputies' ideological, political, and disciplinary conduct
